main_body: Pink blossom tree: a large rounded canopy blob (rows 0-31) on a short brown trunk (rows 32-40) with a small green grass base
top_band: none as a flat surface. The canopy is a rounded organic volume. At x=15 the top rows 1-11 are dark and mid magenta, with the lightest pink at rows 12-13 and 24-31
evidence: The contract targets flat-topped objects, and this is an organic tree. The canopy reads as a rounded volume, lit from the upper right and shaded dark underneath along rows 17-22. The trunk (rows 32-40) stands on a grass patch and sits in the canopy's shadow. There is no side face, no flat elevation, and no top-down slab. I am passing it as a plausible organic 3/4 tree, not as a drawing with a measured top band.

style.evidence: The canopy uses a 5-step pink ramp (#6a2048, #a03460, #d0587a, #ee8ea0, #f9c4c8) with a dark magenta-tinted outline, so the outline is not near-black. The measured facts are far below both references: 11 distinct colours against 427 and 567, and a median of 5 colours per tile against 108 and 109. The canopy is clumped but coarse, with no per-leaf variation or fine grain. The trunk is nearly flat brown with a single strip of highlight, and the grass base is just a few flat greens. Beside the references it looks much thinner and flatter.
